questions.text: In a circle, the numerical value of the arc length of a sector equals the numerical value of the area of that sector. If the central angle is not \(0\), find it.

questions.text: Two triangles have the same area. The first triangle has side lengths of $5$ and $8$ with an included angle of $15^\circ$. The second triangle has side lengths of $4$ and $10$ with an included obtuse angle $\theta$. What is the degree measure of $\theta$?
